questions.q: Why does Guillen worry about birth rates?
a: Too few children to replace and support older generations
questions.why: Lesson 1 argues we face a baby drought, not overpopulation.

questions.q: What does the summary give as the main reason birth rates fell?
a: More women in the workforce who wait longer
questions.why: Women working tend to have children later, lowering birth rates.

questions.q: What milestone is predicted for women's wealth by 2030?
a: Women will hold over half of the world's wealth
Women will earn equal pay everywhere
Women will make up half of CEOs
questions.why: Lesson 2 predicts women will hold more than half of global wealth.

questions.q: Why will businesses compete more for workers?
a: Low birth rates and an aging population shrink the pool
questions.why: Lesson 2 says the qualified worker pool will shrink.

questions.q: What makes a blockchain hard to tamper with?
a: Each transaction block is encrypted and strung together
A central bank guards the records
questions.why: Lesson 3 says the code of linked blocks can't be altered without being noticed.
